mapper.sql: project_id as projectId, system_code as systemCode, screen_id as screenId, html, created_at as createdAt, generation_state as state, failed_reason as failedReason, generation_id as generationId, generation_started_at as generationStartedAt, source_fingerprint as sourceFingerprint, generator_version as generatorVersion
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_user_manual (project_id, system_code, screen_id, html, created_at, generation_state, failed_reason, generation_id, generation_started_at, source_fingerprint, generator_version) values (#{projectId}, #{systemCode}, #{screenId}, #{html}, now(), #{state}, #{failedReason}, concat('direct-', md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text)), now(), #{sourceFingerprint}, #{generatorVersion}) on conflict (project_id, system_code, screen_id) do update set html = excluded.html, created_at = excluded.created_at, generation_state = excluded.generation_state, failed_reason = excluded.failed_reason, generation_id = excluded.generation_id, generation_started_at = excluded.generation_started_at, source_fingerprint = excluded.source_fingerprint, generator_version = excluded.generator_version, capture_bundle_path = null, capture_file_name = null, capture_label = null, capture_width = null, capture_height = null, capture_sha256 = null

insert into builder.adk_builder_user_manual (project_id, system_code, screen_id, html, created_at, generation_state, failed_reason, generation_id, generation_started_at) values (#{projectId}, #{systemCode}, #{screenId}, null, null, 'RUNNING', null, #{generationId}, now()) on conflict (project_id, system_code, screen_id) do update set generation_state = 'RUNNING', failed_reason = null, generation_id = excluded.generation_id, generation_started_at = excluded.generation_started_at where adk_builder_user_manual.generation_state != 'RUNNING' or adk_builder_user_manual.generation_started_at < #{staleBefore}
mapper.sql: project_id as projectId, system_code as systemCode, screen_id as screenId, html, created_at as createdAt, capture_bundle_path as captureBundlePath, capture_file_name as captureFileName, capture_label as captureLabel, capture_width as captureWidth, capture_height as captureHeight, capture_sha256 as captureSha256
mapper.select: select from builder.adk_builder_user_manual where project_id = #{projectId} and html is not null and html <> '' order by system_code, screen_id
